about: Golden cases for the Doorman judge. Written, hashed and timestamped before the first run (golden.lock.json). Scored per item on PASS or FAIL, the only thing validators compare. H1 to H3 are held out: no expected answer, never used to tune the prompt, their labels are reported exactly as they come out.
gate: eval/kiln.json, opened for the run as the 'Kiln golden gate'. Question indexes below are positions in that bank (0 links, 1 unlocks, 2 bug reports, 3 raids, 4 roles, 5 DMs, 6 price talk, 7 disagreeing).
